candidate_claims.statement: The title of the game is Galacta: The Battle for Saturn.
Galacta: The Battle for Saturn was released in November 1992 on DOS.
Galacta: The Battle for Saturn has a shareware business model.
Galacta: The Battle for Saturn has 1 Player as its Number of Offline Players.
Galacta: The Battle for Saturn has 3 people in Credits.
Albino Frog Software, Inc. is listed as a publisher of Galacta: The Battle for Saturn.
Sean Michael Puckett is credited for Design, Graphics, and Programming in the DOS version of Galacta: The Battle for Saturn.

Graphics	Sean Michael Puckett
Programming	Sean Michael Puckett
